description_en: Creates or updates the asynchronous invocation configuration for a function
description_zh: 创建或更新函数的异步调用配置
kebab_example: aliyun fc put-async-invoke-config --function-name my-func --qualifier LATEST --region cn-hangzhou
name: PutAsyncInvokeConfig

parameters.help_en: Optional. Specify whether to enable the asynchronous task feature
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启异步任务（非必填）
parameters.name: async_task

fields.help_en: The descriptor of the destination for the asynchronous invocation
fields.help_zh: 异步调用目标资源描述符
fields.name: destination

fields.help_en: The struct of the destination for the asynchronous invocation

parameters.help_en: Optional. The struct of the destination of asynchronous invocations
parameters.help_zh: 异步调用目标的配置结构体（非必填）
parameters.name: destination_config

parameters.help_en: Optional. The maximum validity period of a message. Valid values: [1,604800]. Default value: 86400. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh: 消息最大存活时长（非必填），取值范围[1,604800]，默认为86400，单位为秒
parameters.name: max_async_event_age_in_seconds

parameters.help_en: Optional. The maximum number of retries if an asynchronous invocation fails. Valid values: [0,8]. If you do not configure this parameter, the default number of retries is 3
parameters.help_zh: 异步调用失败后的最大重试次数，非必填。取值范围[0,8]。当您未进行配置时，系统内部默认重试次数为3
parameters.name: max_async_retry_attempts
